about.title: About Gwinnett County Public Schools
about.content: Gwinnett County Public Schools, also known as GCPS, serves students in Gwinnett County and the Atlanta metro area. The district calendar helps families track the first day of school, digital learning days, early release days, school holidays, fall break, Thanksgiving break, winter break, spring break, and the last day of school.

about.title: How to Use This GCPS Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide school-year planning. Families should still confirm school-specific bell schedules, testing dates, graduation events, athletics, and emergency schedule changes through GCPS and their assigned school.

customSections.label: GCPS 2026-2027 Calendar Overview
customSections.content: The Gwinnett County Public Schools 2026-2027 calendar follows a traditional school-year schedule with 180 student days. The school year begins on August 5, 2026 and ends on May 26, 2027. Families planning vacations, childcare, transportation, and after-school activities should pay special attention to fall break, Thanksgiving break, winter break, spring break, digital learning days, teacher planning days, and early release periods. Unlike a simple holiday list, the GCPS calendar includes academic schedule details that affect whether students attend school in person, learn digitally, or follow a shortened day. Elementary and middle school early release days are listed separately from high school exam early release days, and teacher planning or staff development days may be student holidays. Use this page as a planning reference, then confirm official changes, school-specific events, testing, athletics, and graduation information directly with GCPS or the assigned school.

customSections.label: Gwinnett County Public Schools Calendar Planning Notes
customSections.content: GCPS calendars include districtwide school holidays, teacher planning and staff development days, digital learning days, and early release windows. Families with students in multiple grade levels should review early release notes carefully because elementary, middle, and high school schedules are not always the same.

customSections.label: Changes From 2025-2026
customSections.content: Compared with the 2025-2026 GCPS calendar, the 2026-2027 school year starts one day later, moving from August 4, 2025 to August 5, 2026. The scheduled last day moves from May 20, 2026 to May 26, 2027. Fall Break remains in October, shifting from October 9-13 in 2025 to October 12-16 in 2026. Winter Break continues to run from late December through New Year's Day, and Spring Break remains in early April, moving from April 6-10 in 2026 to April 5-9 in 2027. The 2026-2027 calendar also lists digital learning days and early release periods that families should review separately from holiday breaks.

districtFaqs.q: Which Gwinnett County Public Schools calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes the official GCPS school year calendar PDFs for the listed school years.

districtFaqs.q: Does GCPS use digital learning days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. GCPS calendars list digital learning days during the school year, and the district notes that inclement weather make-up time may use digital learning days or an extended school day or year.

districtFaqs.q: Are GCPS teacher planning days student holidays?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The GCPS calendars list teacher planning and staff development days as student holidays when they occur during the school year.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Gwinnett County Public Schools calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official GCPS calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Gwinnett County Public Schools.

districtFaqs.q: Does GCPS have school on Friday before Thanksgiving?
districtFaqs.a: No. For 2026-2027, GCPS Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, 2026, so Friday, November 27 is included in the break.

districtFaqs.q: How many school days are in GCPS 2026-2027?
districtFaqs.a: The reviewed GCPS 2026-2027 calendar lists 180 student days.

districtFaqs.q: Does GCPS have early release days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The 2026-2027 calendar lists early release days for elementary and middle schools on October 28-29, 2026 and March 3-4, 2027. It also lists high school exam early release windows on December 16-18, 2026 and May 24-26, 2027.

districtFaqs.q: Is the GCPS calendar the same for all schools?
districtFaqs.a: The district calendar is the main source for districtwide dates, but school-specific bell schedules, testing, athletics, graduation, and program events may differ. Families should confirm campus-level dates with their assigned school.

districtFaqs.q: Does GCPS have school on Monday after Winter Break?
districtFaqs.a: No. For 2026-2027, Monday, January 4, 2027 is listed as a teacher planning and staff development day. Students begin the second semester on Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

GCPS publishes a traditional school-year calendar for districtwide planning. The official calendar also lists digital learning days, early release dates, teacher planning days, staff development days, holidays, and translated calendar PDFs.
